text.p: These are the leading stories in the Namibian press on Tuesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The wreck of a missing Cessna aircraft was found in a remote valley in southwestern Namibia after a five-day search. There were no survivors.
- The burnt-out wreck of a missing Cessna aircraft was miraculously spotted by the last plane that took part in a search mission.
- There are no plans to stop using DDT pesticide as part of the Malaria Control Programme. A senior Health Ministry official said DDT was considered safe at the current concentration level used.
- A Cessna 210 plane that went missing last Thursday with five people on board has been found in a deep valley in the Namib Naukluft park on southwestern Namibia.
